trial_court: learned Additional District & Sessions Judge-I, Patna in Sessions Trial No. 799 of 2019 arising out of Bhagwanganj P.S. Case No. 168 of 2018
case_name: Sonu Kumar vs The State Of Bihar

parties.petitioner_plaintiff: Sonu Kumar, Son of Chhotelal Ram R/O Vill.- Karwan, P.S.- Bhawanganj, Dist.- Patna
parties.respondent_defendant: 1. The State of Bihar, 2. Arun Kumar Rabani Son of Mithalesh Ram R/O Vill.- Angarpatra Kali Road, Modi, D.10 Number Sijua, P.s.- Jogata, Dist.- Dhanbad, Jharkhand

facts_of_case: The appellant has been convicted for the offences punishable under Sections 341/34, 366/34 and 376 of the Indian Penal Code.

legal_principles.principle: The burden lies on the accused to prove that the conviction is not based on any material contradiction.
legal_principles.held: It is contended that for the alleged occurrence which took place on 4.12.2018, a written complaint was given on 20.12.2018.

legal_principles.principle: The court should not discard the theory of the prosecution merely because medical evidence does not support it.
legal_principles.held: Merely because the medical evidence does not support the version of the prosecution, the benefit of the same may not be given to the appellant at this stage and the theory of the prosecution may not be discarded.

outcome.final_order: The sentence imposed by the learned trial court has been suspended.

use_for_drafting: seeking relief under Specific Relief Act
